newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.03/5.07 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.03/5.07 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $28.0 billion in three- and six-month bills is likely to produce average rates of 5.03 percent and 5.07 percent, respectively, traders said.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EST/1800 GMT.
In when-issued trade shortly before the bidding deadline, three-month bill rates were trading at 5.025 percent and six-month rates traded at 5.07 percent.
The Treasury sells bills on a weekly basis and the market routinely "digests" them smoothly. This auction should be no exception, traders said. -- N.A. Treasury Desk 212-859-1679
